stories_kpis.title: First Loss Prevention Colloquium
stories_kpis.description: IVR organized its inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp on November 4, 2024, bringing together 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany to discuss technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland shipping. Eight presentations covered topics including collision prevention, safety culture, decarburization impacts, hull damage trends, and clean shipping solutions.

stories_kpis.title: Successful Frankfurt Congress
stories_kpis.description: The 2024 IVR Annual Congress held May 15-17 in Frankfurt attracted 225 participants from 11 European countries. The congress featured workshops on inland waterway value and versatility, presentations on vessel safety, legal frameworks, sustainability, and concluded with general assembly meetings and networking events aboard the Maria Sibylla Merian.
